propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes intermittently on Python 3.11 with 'node down: Not properly terminated' during test_matching_guard_is_accepted teardown
CPython issue 86296 causes asyncio.wait_for to consume external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn, leaving worker task with cancelling()=1 and blocking queue.get()
Crash is fixed by replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=X) with async with asyncio.timeout(X): await asyncio.to_thread(...), restoring correct cancellation semantics
Original hypothesis of orphaned default-executor thread was falsified; proven mechanism is cancellation bug specific to Python 3.11
Teardown flake reproduces locally under CPU/memory contention with OSError across xdist worker channels
